messages:
jess: Kicking off a 2-week SI shadowing sprint for the new integrator cohort. Goal: get 3 SI teams live with our Marketplace listing and a basic Dedicated deployment test by EOW week 2. Quick poll — who can mentor calls + pairing sessions next week? Here's the draft plan:

```
Week 1:
Mon - intro + infra walkthrough (1h)
Tue - hands-on: deploy sample svc (2h)
Wed - shadowing: customer POC call (1h)
Thu - lab: VPC private deploy + KMS (3h)
Fri - retro + cert checklist
Week 2:
Mon-Wed - paired build & marketplace listing
Thu - dry-run announcement & press checklist
Fri - final demo + sign-off
```

mike: I'm available Tue/Thu mornings for pairing. can take 2 teams. @jess add me to the doc.

anita: +1 on hands-on lab. will prepare a short 'quantization & perf' primer (20m).

liam: how are we handling certification? is there a checklist? we need SI creds for marketplace listing.

carla: FYI legal wants the joint announcement draft 48h before dry-run. will sync with comms.

onboard-bot: calendar invites created: SI-shadowing-sprint - see #calendar (https://calendar.redwood.example.com/event/12345).

jess: action items:
- @mike confirm mentor slots
- @anita upload perf primer
- @liam draft cert checklist
- @carla coordinate legal/comms timeline
I'll share recording templates + evaluation rubric. Link: https://redwood.example.com/si/onboard/sprint-v1

mike: added availability to doc. also recommend 1 pilot SI for week0 shadowing.

anita: uploaded primer to the doc. brief outline: perf baselines, batching tips, KV cache notes.

liam: started cert checklist draft: onboarding steps, joint-runbook, test cases. will post by EOD.

carla: I'll book 30m with comms and legal Wed afternoon. cc: @jess

jess: perfect. we'll run a dry-run with internal SRE Thursday next week. pls add test accounts. :thumbsup:
